column1: # The declared ReviewBench metadata-only 24-task HOLDOUT base/head world archives
# Emitted by the real acquisition of the frozen holdout 24 tasks' exact base and head
# commits from the canonical `review-bench` source mirrors; the acquisition repository
# rule verifies each declared digest before the bytes enter the study, so a mutated
# or substituted archive fails the fetch. The holdout tasks are the frozen
# metadata-only selection drawn from the remaining fast cohort and EXCLUDE every
# original24 task, so no heldout world is a pilot world. Owned by
# Attune.Study.ReviewPilot (the holdout identity and the task/world derivation);
# no revision or digest is restated elsewhere.
